headline: Council pay, staggered terms, and term limits drew most of the discussion on the city council section.
summary: Ideas included higher pay, staggered terms, and clearer recall rules. The next meeting will cover the mayor's role and the budget committee.
discussion: Council pay: Speakers said the $100 monthly pay is too low and suggested setting it through the budget process instead of the charter.
Staggered terms and length: Speakers weighed two-year terms against three-year terms, and staggered terms that keep some experienced councilors in office.
Term limits: Speakers were divided on whether to limit how long councilors can serve, with some saying voters can already remove them at the ballot box.
Recall and vacancies: Speakers discussed easier recall, filling vacancies through the next election, and treating three unexcused absences as a vacancy.
Public engagement: Speakers suggested ward meetings, participatory budgeting, and better use of technology to alert residents about upcoming votes.
